arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed_jobs FROM failed_jobs

arguments.recommended_next_step: Analyze the failed_jobs table export to identify the root cause of the failures and take corrective actions to resolve them and keep the backlog moving.
arguments.summary: Investigated the failed-jobs backlog and found growing failures in the jobs database. The read replica is 12 minutes behind and the primary query shows the current failed-job count for the postmortem.
